cues.en: Recitativo (Tenor) [Narrator]
Keep quiet,
don’t chatter
and hear what’s going on now:

cues.zh: 施伦德里安先生带着女儿莉丝根来了，
cues.en: here comes Herr Schlendrian with his daughter Liesgen

cues.zh: 他像只蜜熊似的哼哼唧唧，
cues.en: he’s growling like a honey-bear

cues.zh: 你们自己听听，她把他气成什么样。
cues.en: hear for yourselves what she has done to him.

cues.zh: 咏叹调（男低音）【施伦德里安】
cues.en: Aria (Bass) [Schlendrian]
Don’t we have with our children,

cues.zh: 难道不是有数不清的烦心事吗！
cues.en: a hundred thousand muddles !
Don’t we have with our children,

cues.zh: 难道不是有数不清的烦心事吗！
cues.en: a hundred thousand muddles !
What always every day
I say to my daughter Liesgen
goes in one ear and out the other.

cues.zh: 施伦德里安：你这淘气鬼，野丫头！
cues.en: Schlendrian: You naughty child, you wild girl!

cues.zh: 唉！要是能如我所愿就好了：
cues.en: Oh! If only I could have my way:
get rid of coffee!

cues.zh: 莉丝根：爸爸，别这么严厉！
cues.en: Liesgen: Father, don’t be so hard!

cues.zh: 要是我一天不能喝上三小杯咖啡，
cues.en: If three times a day I can’t drink my little cup of coffee,
then I would become so upset

cues.zh: 就像一块干巴巴的烤山羊肉。
cues.en: that I would be like a dried up piece of roast goat.
Aria (Soprano) [Liesgen]
Ah! how sweet coffee tastes!
Lovelier than a thousand kisses,

cues.zh: 比麝香葡萄酒还要醇柔。
cues.en: smoother than muscatel wine.
Coffee, Coffee!
I must have coffee!
and if anyone wants to give me a treat,
ah!, just give me some coffee!
Recitativo

cues.zh: 施伦德里安：你要是不戒咖啡，
cues.en: Schlendrian: If you don’t give up coffee,
you won’t be going to any wedding
and you won’t go out walking either.
Liesgen: Alright then!

cues.zh: 只要让我留着咖啡就行！
cues.en: Just leave me my coffee!

cues.zh: 施伦德里安：我这就来治治你这个小淘气！
cues.en: Schlendrian: I’ll get the little minx now!

cues.zh: 我不会给你买最新款的漂亮裙子。
cues.en: I will buy you no beautiful dress of the latest fashion.
Liesgen: I can easily do without that.
Schlendrian: You’re not to stand at the window
and you won’t see anyone going by!
Liesgen: I don’t mind that either;

cues.zh: 可求求你，让我留着咖啡吧！
cues.en: but please, I beg you, just let me keep my coffee!

cues.zh: 施伦德里安：还有，我也不会给你
cues.en: Schlendrian: What’s more you won’t get from me
a silver or gold ribbon
to put on your bonnet!
Liesgen: That’s fine!

cues.zh: 就让我享受这份快乐吧！
cues.en: Just leave me my pleasure!
Schlendrian: You’re impossible Liesgen, you are,

cues.zh: 难道我说什么你都要反着来？
cues.en: you would give up everything I say?
Aria (Bass) [Schlendrian]
Girls with obstinate minds
are not easily won over.

cues.zh: 可要是说到了她的心坎上，
cues.en: But if you hit the right spot,
oh then you’re in luck.
Recitativo
Schlendrian: Now follow what your father says!

cues.zh: Liesgen：别的事都行，就是咖啡不行。
cues.en: Liesgen: In everything else, but not coffee.

cues.zh: Schlendrian：那好！你得做好心理准备，
cues.en: Schendrian: Well then! You must get used to the idea
that you won’t have a husband either.
Liesgen: Oh yes!
Father, a husband!
Schlendrian: I swear, that won’t happen.
Liesgen: Until I can give up coffee?
Right! Coffee, will remain forever untouched

cues.zh: 爸爸，你听着，我一口也不喝。
cues.en: Father, listen, I won’t drink any at all.
Schlendrian: Then you’ll have a husband!
Aria (Soprano) [Liesgen]
This very day, This very day,

cues.zh: 亲爱的爸爸，现在就成全我吧！
cues.en: dear father, do it now!

cues.zh: 啊，一个丈夫。啊，一个丈夫！
cues.en: Ah, a husband. Ah, a husband!
That’s just right for me!
That’s just right for me!---

cues.zh: 要是能马上如愿就好了，
cues.en: If only it could happen at once,
so that at last instead of coffee
before I go to bed

cues.zh: 而是能拥有一个健壮的爱人！
cues.en: I could get a lusty lover!
Recitativo (Tenor) [Narrator]

cues.zh: 现在老施伦德里安出去打探，
cues.en: Now old Schlendrian goes off and looks out

cues.zh: 为他的女儿莉斯根寻觅，
cues.en: for his daughter Liesgen

cues.zh: 看能否尽快给她找个丈夫。
cues.en: to see if he can get her a husband soon.
But

cues.zh: 莉斯根却私下放出话来：
cues.en: Liesgen lets it be secretly known:
"No suitor of mine should come to the house
unless he himself has promised
and it is written also in the marriage contract
that I shall be permitted
to make coffee whenever I want."
Chorus (Trio)
The cat does not leave the mouse,
young ladies remain coffee addicts.

cues.zh: 做母亲的爱喝她那杯咖啡，
cues.en: The mother loves her cup of coffee

cues.zh: 做祖母的当年也是如此。
cues.en: the grandmother drank it also.
Who can blame the daughters!
The cat does not leave the mouse,

cues.zh: 年轻姑娘们依旧是咖啡上瘾者。
cues.en: young ladies remain coffee addicts.
The mother loves her cup of coffee
the grandmother drank it also.
Who can blame the daughters!
Johann Sebastian Bach

cues.zh: 《安静吧，别闲聊》“咖啡康塔塔” BWV 211
cues.en: Schweigt stille, plaudert nicht "Coffee Cantata" BWV 211
